verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models, with local and cloud base URLs, curl examples, and API-key access to cloud models. It also ships official Python and JavaScript libraries plus OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and its llms.txt advertises a simple API. Community users report driving it programmatically, such as hot-swapping models for a Discord bot and embedding it into a product. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and more direct independent hands-on corroboration of the API docs' depth.
